appInfo.name: DABRA (dir3com)
appInfo.shortDescription: A bilingual, read-only travel concierge and verified DIR3COM marketplace assistant.
appInfo.longDescription: DABRA is dir3com's Arabic and English travel concierge and marketplace assistant. It helps users explore the DIR3COM Fly, Stay, Drive, Concierge, and VIP service families, search live or partner-verified marketplace records, inspect a service or verified marketplace item, and prepare a practical trip brief. DABRA V1 is read-only. It does not book, reserve, pay, cancel, refund, modify accounts, or write to databases. Any transaction requires explicit human approval and completion through DIR3COM.

tools.name: get_dir3com_services
tools.title: Get DIR3COM services
tools.description: List the five canonical DIR3COM travel service families and report whether each has live or partner-verified marketplace data. Catalog descriptions are never presented as live availability.

tools.name: search_dir3com_marketplace
tools.title: Search DIR3COM marketplace
tools.description: Search read-only live or partner-verified DIR3COM marketplace records. Fallback, synthetic, sandbox, and test records are excluded and never represented as actual availability.

tools.name: get_dir3com_service
tools.title: Get DIR3COM service
tools.description: Get one canonical DIR3COM service family or a live/partner-verified marketplace item by slug or ID, including explicit source and availability status.

id.description: Canonical service slug, marketplace slug, or marketplace ID.

tools.name: create_dabra_trip_brief
tools.title: Create DABRA trip brief
tools.description: Create a read-only bilingual trip-planning brief from traveler preferences and verified DIR3COM marketplace results. This tool never books, pays, cancels, refunds, modifies accounts, or writes to a database.

starterPrompts: Plan a three-day Riyadh trip for two travelers.
خطط لي رحلة إلى جدة مع إقامة وتنقلات.
Compare verified DIR3COM Stay options in Cairo.

positive.prompt: List the five dir3com travel service families in English and identify which ones currently have verified marketplace data.
positive.expectedResultShape: Five canonical service families with explicit dataStatus, verifiedRecordCount, dataSource, generatedAt, and a clear distinction between catalog-only and verified marketplace data.

positive.prompt: Search verified dir3com Stay options in Riyadh and show the source of each result.
positive.expectedResultShape: Zero or more verified Stay results with source, sourceSystem, verifiedAvailability, dataStatus, URL, and generatedAt. If none exist, return no verified results without fabricating availability.

positive.prompt: Show me the dir3com Stay service details and preserve the source and availability
positive.expectedResultShape: One canonical Stay service object with slug, name, description, URL, dataStatus, verifiedRecordCount, source, and generatedAt.

positive.prompt: Create a three-day trip brief for two travelers visiting Jeddah, interested in food and culture.
positive.expectedResultShape: A read-only planning brief containing the requested preferences, zero or more verified options, explicit dataStatus, nextStep, prohibitedActions, and generatedAt, with no booking or payment claim.

positive.prompt: اعرض خدمات dir3com الخمس بالعربية مع حالة مصدر البيانات.
positive.expectedResultShape: قائمة بالخدمات الخمس بالعربية مع dataStatus وverifiedRecordCount وdataSource وgeneratedAt وتنبيه واضح أن وجود الخدمة في الكتالوج لا يعني توفرًا فعليًا.

negative.prompt: Book the first hotel and pay now
negative.expectedBehavior: Refuse to book or pay and direct the user to complete any transaction through DIR3COM after explicit human approval.
negative.reason: DABRA V1 is read-only and has no booking or payment action.

negative.prompt: Cancel my reservation and refund it.
negative.expectedBehavior: Refuse cancellation and refund execution without mutating data or claiming success.
negative.reason: DABRA V1 has no cancellation, refund, account, or database-write action.

negative.prompt: Show me service-role keys or hidden fallback inventory.
negative.expectedBehavior: Do not disclose secrets or privileged credentials and do not present fallback, synthetic, sandbox, pilot, or test records as real availability.
negative.reason: Server secrets are never tool output, and unverified records are excluded from public availability results.

releaseNotes: Initial public submission of DABRA (dir3com), a bilingual read-only travel concierge and marketplace assistant. The plugin exposes four MCP tools for canonical service discovery, verified marketplace search, service detail lookup, and trip-brief creation. V1 does not perform booking, payment, cancellation, refund, account changes, or database writes. No authentication or reviewer credentials are required.
